name: opendatalab-mineru-ecosystem
description: Official MinerU document parsing MCP ([mineru-open-mcp](https://pypi.org/project/mineru-open-mcp/) on PyPI). Converts PDFs, doc/docx/ppt/pptx, images, and spreadsheets to Markdown via the [MinerU](https://mineru.net) API; free Flash mode without an API key (about 20 pages per file); optional `MINERU_API_TOKEN` for higher limits.
